## Summary

Describe the change and its scientific or user-facing purpose.

## Verification

- [ ] Tests added or updated.
- [ ] Known-answer numerical behavior checked where applicable.
- [ ] Ruff formatting and linting pass.
- [ ] Coverage remains at or above the configured threshold.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog updated.

## Scientific/data review

- [ ] Assumptions and limitations are documented.
- [ ] No private data, credentials, or unlicensed material is included.
- [ ] Input transformations are explicit and reproducible.

## Release impact

- [ ] No public API change.
- [ ] Public API or result-format change documented.
- [ ] An ADR is included for a long-term architectural/scientific decision.
